'''Caldo tlalpeño''' is a chicken and vegetable stew in [[Mexican cuisine]] which contains [[Chicken (food)|chicken meat]], and [[chickpea]]s, [[carrot]]s, and [[green bean]]s, submerged in a chicken broth with garlic and onion, seasoned with [[epazote]], cumin and [[chipotle]] chili.<ref>{{cite book|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=YrZQAQAAIAAJ|title=Larousse de la cocina mexicana|access-date=29 November 2014|isbn=9789702216858|last1=De'Angeli|first1=Alicia Gironella|last2=Deangeli|first2=Giorgio|year=2006|publisher=Larousse}}</ref> It is served with [[avocado]] slices and diced cheese, and accompanied with lime.
